purpose: Fail-closed acceptance contract for ADR-0080 and later M9-M12 design work

parallel_fixture_constraints: not admissible as milestone acceptance evidence

authority_owners.opportunity_greenlight: Human Greenlight custodian defined by M9 design
authority_owners.quality_disposition: Human QualityDispositionAuthority defined by M10 design
authority_owners.packaging_selection: M10 Packaging Authority defined by M10 design
authority_owners.publish_approval: Human PublishApprovalAuthority defined by M11 design

schema_freeze_protocol.rule: Each milestone freezes its own contract and evidence hashes at that milestone's design acceptance; future hashes are not required for ADR-0080 acceptance.

required_contract_domains: provider session reconciliation and webhook inbox
data refresh, revocation and deletion operations
append-only correction, withdrawal and deletion propagation

revalidate_at: each policy-version change detected by the adapter
required_evidence: retention, refresh, revocation and deletion semantics

reviewer_qualification_criteria: can trace M7 and M8 authority ownership
can evaluate append-only identity, idempotency, CAS and unknown-outcome recovery
can evaluate platform credential, consent, retention and deletion constraints
declares conflicts and did not author the reviewed candidate

acceptance_commit_policy: accepted_candidate_head equals the exact commit reviewed by both reviewers
acceptance commit has accepted_candidate_head as its parent
acceptance commit changes only ADR-0080 status and architecture acceptance evidence
contract_sha256, reviewed_adr_sha256 and research_sha256 recompute exactly at accepted_candidate_head
accepted_adr_sha256 recomputes exactly after the status-only ADR transition in the acceptance commit

implementation_prerequisite.rule: Architecture acceptance permits design and implementation planning only. M9 code starts from the independently accepted M8 implementation commit; later code starts from the independently accepted predecessor milestone.

stop_codes.POST_M8_PREREQUISITE_NOT_ACCEPTED: Required predecessor implementation acceptance is absent, stale or mismatched.
stop_codes.POST_M8_SCHEMA_FREEZE_FAILED: The milestone schema-freeze record is missing, incomplete or has mismatched hashes.
stop_codes.POST_M8_BASE_SEAM_CHANGED: An accepted M7, M8 or host authority seam is absent or materially changed.
stop_codes.POST_M8_SCOPE_EXPANSION_REQUIRED: Work requires files, authority or behavior outside the accepted packet allowlist.
stop_codes.POST_M8_CREDENTIAL_CUSTODY_UNPROVEN: Credential reference, scope, refresh, revocation or non-leakage proof is incomplete.
stop_codes.POST_M8_PROVIDER_POLICY_STALE: First-party provider policy evidence is missing, stale or incompatible with the requested operation.
stop_codes.POST_M8_DATA_DELETION_UNPROVEN: Idempotent deletion, correction, withdrawal, deadline or fail-closed propagation evidence is incomplete.
stop_codes.POST_M8_UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_UNRECONCILED: A provider operation has no durable identity or cannot be reconciled after an unknown outcome.
stop_codes.POST_M8_REVIEW_INDEPENDENCE_FAILED: Reviewer qualification, independence, rubric or PASS evidence is incomplete.
stop_codes.POST_M8_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING: A required fixture, test, digest, lineage field or evidence artifact is absent.
stop_codes.POST_M8_PACKET_ORDER_VIOLATION: A packet treats a planned or unaccepted predecessor as available.
stop_codes.POST_M8_MIGRATION_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION: Migration is nonlinear, has multiple heads, lacks restore proof or crosses milestone ownership.
stop_codes.POST_M8_PRODUCTION_OPERATION_NOT_AUTHORI: The requested credential, provider, migration, runtime, upload or public operation is not explicitly authorized.
